tagline: Premier gaming and hospitality REIT with diversified tenant base and long-term lease agreements
hero_kpi_rationale: Key measure of operational performance for REITs, reflecting profitability before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, enabling robust sector comparability

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.description: Key indicator of financial performance and capacity for shareholder distributions
kpis.signal: Increase of 5.6% compared to the prior year ($3,104,917K in 2024)

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.description: Net income attributable to common shareholders, indicator of net profitability
kpis.signal: Increase of 3.6% compared to the prior year ($2,678,810K in 2024)

kpis.name: Funds from operations
kpis.description: Supplementary NAREIT measure of REITs' operational performance, excluding gains on sales and real estate amortization
kpis.signal: Increase of 3.6% compared to the prior year ($2,678,810K in 2024)

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.description: Key indicator of financial performance and capacity for shareholder distributions
kpis.signal: Increase of 5.6% compared to the prior year ($3,104,917K in 2024)

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury).
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + share buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

kpis.name: Adjusted Funds From Operations
kpis.explanation: Mesure non-GAAP clé pour les REITs, ajustant le FFO des éléments non-cash et non-récurrents pour refléter la performance opérationnelle réelle.
kpis.description: VICI's AFFO reached $2.53 Bn in 2025, up $155.5 M from 2024. This progression reflects growth in contractual rental revenues and loan revenues.

kpis.name: Contractual Rental Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenus locatifs effectivement encaissables (hors ajustements non-cash de comptabilisation en intérêts effectifs), reflétant les loyers réels perçus.
kpis.description: Contractual rental revenues increased by $87.2 M in 2025, driven by investments in Venetian Resort through the Partner Property Growth Fund and annual rent escalators.

kpis.name: Credit Loss Allowance (CECL)
kpis.explanation: Provision comptable reflétant l'évolution du risque de défaut estimé sur les créances locatives et prêts, selon le modèle CECL (Current Expected Credit Losses).
kpis.description: CECL provision jumped $51.2 M in 2025, reflecting deteriorating tenant default probabilities and increased loan origination activity. Caution signal on portfolio quality.

kpis.name: Weighted Average Debt Rate
kpis.explanation: Taux d'intérêt annualisé moyen sur l'ensemble de la dette de VICI, net de l'impact des swaps de taux et treasury locks.
kpis.description: Weighted average debt rate increased from 4.34% to 4.46% in 2025, due to refinancing at higher rates (March 2024, December 2024, and April 2025 notes). Moderate pressure on financing charges.

kpis.name: Loan Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenus d'intérêts générés par les investissements en dette (prêts) de VICI, reflétant la diversification au-delà des baux traditionnels.
kpis.description: Loan revenues surged $83.9 M (+62.4%) in 2025, driven by origination of new debt investments and growth in loan portfolio. Demonstrates VICI's credit diversification strategy gaining momentum.

risks.title: Short-term debt refinancing
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions significant debt maturities in 2026 ($1.75B) in a high-interest-rate environment. Language emphasizes uncertainty in accessing capital markets. Recurring risk amplified by tight macroeconomic conditions. High weighting for a liquidity risk at a REIT.

risks.title: Dependence on capital market conditions
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicitly listed at the top of risk factors: dependence on economic conditions, REIT markets, and stock price. Strong language: 'may not be consistently available'. Less existential than refinancing but structural. Capital category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Tenant credit risk
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section on allowance for credit losses (CECL), with complex PD/LGD modeling. Explicit mention of potentially 'material' impact on results. No loss history but long lease durations. Credit category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Optional future funding commitments
risks.score_rationale: $300M of potential commitments related to Venetian, optional but binding. Mentioned in 'Additional Funding Requirements'. Cautious language but no urgency. Less critical than term debt. Capital category.

risks.title: Sensitivity to variable interest rates
risks.score_rationale: Only 0.8% of debt is variable-rate ($142.5M). Limited impact: +$1.4M/year per 100 bps increase. Mentioned in Item 7A but low exposure. Capital category, but minor risk.

risks.title: Uncertain accounting estimates on leases
risks.score_rationale: 'Critical Accounting Estimates' section on lease classification (ASC 842), with judgments on renewals and residual values. Potential 'material' impact on revenues. Cautious language but no sign of crisis. Industrial category, moderate weighting.

ai_positioning.summary: VICI does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
